# 2026 Sales Compensation Plan (excerpt)

1. Account Executives earn 10% of first-year contract value on new-logo contracts, payable
   in the month after signature. Clawback if the customer does not pay within 90 days.
2. Account Executives earn 2% of contract value on renewals they manage.
3. Sales Development Reps earn $500 for each qualified meeting booked, payable monthly,
   whether or not the prospect ever signs.
4. Sales Managers earn a 1% override on every new-logo contract their team signs.
5. Commissions are paid through payroll and expensed as paid. (Current practice.)
